title: Scripture ledger
description: scripture.json beside a scripture file (temple/scripture.json, characters/<id>/scripture.json; PS-12c): one entry per lesson the machine wrote, in the order it wrote them. Only the Steward writes it, as it applies a temple_report from the inbox (ADR 0005), and only for lines with an id it gave. It keeps the lesson's source, its source verdict or origin, the CLI version and the time it was added, the lines a merge replaced, and, once a line is taken out, when, by whom, why and what it said. The scope and the fail kind stay at the head of the Markdown line, where the owner reads and writes them; helped and missed are computed from load traces, never stored. A line whose id has no entry here is the owner's, and the Monk never retires or merges it. An entry no line carries any more, and not retired, is a line the owner deleted: no error. The file appears with the first temple report applied.
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. Not expressible here: lesson ids are unique.

source_verdict.description: The fail verdict the lesson comes from; required when source = monk.

origin.description: Where a lesson from outside the kingdom came from (lesson-sharing S4, T9).

from.description: The release or the pack the lesson came with.

lesson.description: Its id, or the ref of its sentence, where it came from.

received_at.description: The day the owner took it in.

cli_version.description: The CLI version the lesson was written for (lesson-sharing S5, T7): the checked version of the one tribe its scope names; absent when it names none or several. A record, never a filter.

merged_from.description: The lines a merge replaced with this one.

retired.description: The line was taken out of the Markdown (retire, or merged into another line).

text.description: The sentence of the line as it was taken out.

why.description: Why the Monk retired it (the `why` of `retire`).

merged_into.description: A merge took it out: the line that replaced it.

command.description: The temple_report that took it out, so a report the Steward applies again after a stop takes out nothing twice.

retired.text: Run the tests of the touched package before you hand in.
